title: The change-versus-endpoint choice does not interact with population adjustment
question: When baseline severity modifies the treatment effect, do change-score and endpoint analyses give different target-population contrasts after population adjustment, as the design proposes?
design: Anchored and unanchored comparisons with a continuous outcome and its baseline; 24 cells crossing baseline shift, baseline-by-treatment interaction and baseline-to-follow-up correlation; naive, MAIC and G-computation estimators in both representations. 1000 replicates per cell.
